descriptions.w3d_h1c_editor_keys_80278e38: Dispatches editor keys: Escape returns to the list; Space walks each observed runtime-type parent chain to select a specialized editor, releasing an unsupported selection; Delete finds and removes the selected array entry and refreshes state; other keys select a property editor through two accepted key alphabets. Type identities and field offsets are observed external views; original class names remain unknown.
